title: Restore drill
acceptance: Restore onto another location within the bounds keeping identities, revoked grants and checkpoints; no old work replayed
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-14 from 0.25 h to 0.75 h: feature implementation steps closed since 2026-11-13 took 0.75–1 h (F-066-T01, F-066-T02, F-062-T03, F-044-T01) where the 0.25x pass had set 0.25–1 h; started from this step's estimate, not a ratio.
